title: Associate Salesforce Systems Administrator - US Shift
description:
**About MISUMI Americas**

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

### **What's in it for you?**

**Opportunity To Unlock Your Creativity**  
Think of all the times you were held back from trying new ideas because you were boxed in by bureaucratic legacy processes or old school tactics. Having a growth mindset is deeply ingrained into our company culture since day 1 so Fictiv is an environment where you have the creative liberty and support of the team to try big bold ideas to achieve our sales and customer goals.

**Opportunity To Grow Your Career**  
There are plenty of sales jobs out there. The question is whether any of them will help you grow in your career? Will you be challenged by teammates to achieve your potential? Or are they roles that will ask you to do more of what you've already mastered. At Fictiv, you'll be surrounded by supportive teammates who will push you to be your best through their curiosity and passion.

  

**Role Summary (Impact in this Role): Objective / Purpose of the Position**

The Salesforce System Support Specialist is responsible for performing general declarative Salesforce administrative duties, assisting with the ongoing maintenance and development of our Salesforce instance, helping to deliver high-quality enhancements, and providing 1st tier support for the organization. A Salesforce Admin provides day-to-day support, administration of Salesforce, maintain data cleanliness, and will generate/analyze simple to complex reports.

**Areas of Responsibility: Essential Functions**

  

* Manage Salesforce continuous improvement projects end to end, coordinating cross-functionally as necessary to gather requirements, ideate and decide upon solution paths, implementation and testing.
* Identify areas for improvement and cross-functional dependencies. Brainstorm solutions and suggest optimal solution path.
* Gains a deep understanding of sales systems and processes and provides insights into the impact of any potential configuration changes.
* Manage Salesforce configuration projects, including (but not limited to): Declarative Automation, objects, fields, page layouts, record types, custom settings, dashboards, and reports.
* Assist with onboarding and project training/enablement for sales tools and processes.
* Generates and analyzes simple and complex reports from Salesforce based on business needs as requested by the sales and sales management team
* Provides day-to-day support and administration for Salesforce
* Manage all aspects of user and license management including new user setup/deactivation, roles, profiles, permissions, public groups
* Maintains data cleanliness, identifies, and resolves data inaccuracies within our systems
* User support tickets
* Bulk data management
* Manage deal desk processes

  

**Preferred Experience/Qualifications**

  

* 0-5 years of professional experience as a Salesforce Administrator
* 4-year degree in Information Technology or Computer Science. Degrees in similar analytical areas of study will also be considered.
* Salesforce Admin Certification is a plus.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work as part of a team are essential.
* A successful candidate will also exhibit a strong desire to learn and understand all aspects of the company's operations and be able to interact directly with other departments.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Working knowledge of SQL Server or academic study of SQL is preferred.
* Ability to travel 0-10% annually in the U.S. for team meetings, offsites, etc.

We're actively seeking teammates who:

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an 'always learning' mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

title: Mainframe CICS Systems Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients-which means some of the biggest in the world.

  

Success in this role means delivering a secure, highly available, and high-performing CICS environment that supports mission-critical business applications while driving modernization, automation, and operational excellence.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Install, configure, administer, and support IBM CICS Transaction Server environments across enterprise z/OS platforms.
* Perform CICS upgrades, migrations, maintenance, and lifecycle management while ensuring platform stability, availability, and security.
* Manage and support CICS regions, including AOR, TOR, FOR, COR, and complex CICSplex environments.
* Monitor, analyze, and optimize transaction performance, response times, CPU utilization, storage consumption, and workload distribution.
* Configure and maintain CICS resources, system definitions, startup procedures, CSD/BAS definitions, and operational infrastructure.
* Ensure high availability, resiliency, and disaster recovery readiness through proactive capacity planning, recovery testing, and business continuity strategies.
* Administer and support CICS security controls in partnership with RACF and security teams, including transaction, program, command, resource, and surrogate security.
* Support enterprise connectivity and integration technologies such as MQ, EXCI, DPL, MRO, ISC, IPIC, Web Services, REST APIs, and TCP/IP.
* Serve as the highest level technical escalation point for critical incidents, performing root cause analysis, dump and trace analysis, and resolution of complex CICS abends and system issues.
* Collaborate with application development teams to support testing, deployments, modernization initiatives, and production support for business-critical applications.
* Lead strategic initiatives including CICS TS upgrades, API enablement, modernization programs, hybrid cloud integration, DevOps adoption, and observability enhancements.
* Develop and implement automation solutions using REXX, System Automation, NetView, and OPS/MVS to improve operational efficiency and reliability.
* Administer monitoring and observability platforms such as OMEGAMON, MainView, Dynatrace, Tivoli, SMF, and RMF to proactively identify and resolve issues.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, architectural guidance, and best practices to system programmers, engineers, and support teams.
Ensure compliance with operational, security, audit, and service delivery standards while driving continuous improvement across the CICS platform.  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

  

* 8+ years of relevant hands-on experience in Mainframe CICS System Programming or CICS infrastructure support.
* Good working knowledge of IBM CICS Transaction Server, including CICS regions, system configuration, administration, monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting CICS production environments, including incident resolution, service requests, planned changes, and system maintenance activities.
* Working knowledge of CICS installation, maintenance, upgrades, or migration activities.
* Experience or exposure to CICS-related IBM and third-party products and monitoring tools such as IBM OMEGAMON for CICS, BMC MainView, ASG TMON/CICS, CICS Performance Analyzer, Abend-AID, Xpediter/CICS, InterTest, SymDump, or similar products.
* Understanding of CICS integration with technologies such as IBM MQ, Db2, VSAM, and other Mainframe application components.
* Working knowledge of CICS performance monitoring, transaction analysis, region health monitoring, and basic performance troubleshooting.
Ability and willingness to participate in rotational on-call support, planned maintenance activities, and Disaster Recovery exercises as required.  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

  

* Exposure to CICS Web Services, API enablement, Java integration, or other CICS modernization technologies.
* Experience supporting CICS maintenance using SMP/E and applying IBM PTFs, APAR fixes, or related maintenance.
* Exposure to CICSplex System Manager, CICSPlex SM, Workload Management, or multi-region CICS environments.
* Experience with CICS performance analysis, workload balancing, capacity monitoring, or tuning activities.
Ability to contribute effectively to projects, upgrades, migrations, maintenance activities, and continuous improvement initiatives as part of a broader technical team.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Public Cloud Solutions Architect
description:
**Who We Are**

For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

As a **Public Cloud Solutions Architect** at Kyndryl, you act as the trusted advisor who turns business goals into cloud architecture that actually ships. You work closely with client executives, enterprise architects, security and compliance teams, governance, delivery, and our hyperscaler partners to keep everyone aligned on one technical direction. You get involved early, helping shape the strategy and the migration and modernization roadmap, and you stay through delivery so the architecture goes live on time, on budget, and secure by design.

  
  

**What you will do**  
This is a senior, client-facing role. **To the client, you are the go-to expert on public cloud.** You run discovery and assessment workshops, build the business case and total cost of ownership, and translate requirements into well-architected solutions on AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. Increasingly, that means designing for AI and agentic AI as well, from the data and platform foundations through to the workloads themselves.

  

You will decide what Kyndryl will deliver, design the landing zones, networking, identity, data, and application patterns behind it, and lead the implementation teams to a clean result.
  
  
The role goes beyond any single engagement. You will mentor other architects and consultants, build reference architectures and reusable accelerators, and help set our delivery standards and governance. You will also help set Kyndryl apart through newer capabilities such as agentic AI, automation, and modernization accelerators that improve delivery quality, speed, and the value clients see. Kyndryl works across all the major public cloud platforms, so you will use what you know, keep building on it, and know when to bring in specialist SMEs.
  
  
**Your future at Kyndryl**  
This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Experience**

* 8+ years designing and delivering enterprise IT solutions, including at least 4+ years focused on public cloud architecture
* Deep, hands-on solutions architecture experience on at least one major hyperscaler (Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud) and working knowledge of a second; multi-cloud experience strongly preferred
* A track record leading cloud migration and modernization programs, covering assessment and discovery, the 7 Rs (rehost, replatform, refactor, and so on), landing zone and well-architected design, and large-scale workload migration
* Strong command of core cloud domains: compute, storage, networking (VPC/VNet, hybrid connectivity, DNS, load balancing), identity and access management, and cloud security and governance
* Solid grasp of cloud-native and modernization patterns: containers and Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE), microservices, serverless, and application refactoring
* Hands-on experience designing and delivering AI and agentic AI solutions on cloud, including the underlying data and platform foundations, the AI/ML services across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, and how generative and agentic workloads change architecture, security, and cost
* Experience applying AI to the delivery itself, using AI-led approaches, automation, and agentic tooling to speed up assessment, migration, modernization, and quality assurance
* Experience with infrastructure as code and automation (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep, Ansible) and with CI/CD and DevOps practices
* Practical understanding of security by design, cloud cost optimization (FinOps), and well-architected or cloud adoption frameworks
* Proven consulting skills: running client workshops, building business cases and TCO/ROI models, presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders up to C-level, and guiding delivery teams as the lead architect
At least one current associate- or professional-level cloud certification (for example, AWS Solutions Architect Associate or Professional, Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Professional Cloud Architect)  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* Professional- or expert-tier and multi-cloud certifications across AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Experience in a consulting, professional services, or systems integrator setting delivering cloud work for enterprise clients
* Familiarity with hybrid and on-premises-to-cloud platforms (VMware Cloud Foundation, Nutanix, AWS Outposts, Azure Stack/Arc, Google Distributed Cloud)
* Deeper specialization in agentic AI, such as multi-agent systems, agent orchestration and governance (AgentOps), retrieval-augmented generation, and integrating large language models into enterprise workflows and platforms
* Experience mentoring architects and contributing reusable reference architectures, accelerators, and delivery standards
* Industry or regulated-environment experience (financial services, public sector, healthcare), including data sovereignty and compliance considerations
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the confidence to work with stakeholders at all levels  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. title: Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx

Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

title: Mainframe zOS Systems Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients-which means some of the biggest in the world.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Install, configure, maintain, and upgrade **DB2 for z/OS** environments, ensuring platform stability, performance, and availability.
* Plan and execute DB2 version migrations, maintenance activities, and recovery strategies, including SMP/E, PTF, and APAR implementations.
* Administer DB2 subsystems, DSNZPARM configurations, buffer pools, storage resources, catalogs, and directories.
* Monitor, analyze, and optimize DB2 performance through tuning of subsystem parameters, SQL access paths, buffer pools, and resource utilization.
* Design and support high-availability, disaster recovery, and data-sharing environments to meet business continuity and recovery objectives.
* Manage DB2 utilities including REORG, RUNSTATS, COPY, LOAD/UNLOAD, RECOVER, and REBUILD INDEX operations while ensuring optimal execution and reliability.
* Partner with security teams to implement DB2 security controls, authorization strategies, compliance requirements, and vulnerability remediation.
* Perform capacity planning, growth forecasting, and infrastructure optimization to support evolving business and application demands.
* Develop and enhance automation using REXX, JCL, and monitoring tools to improve operational efficiency and proactive system health management.
* Lead root cause analysis and resolution of critical incidents, acting as the highest level of technical escalation for complex DB2 issues.
* Collaborate with application development teams on SQL tuning, database design reviews, migrations, and onboarding of new workloads.
* Drive modernization initiatives including DB2 upgrades, DevOps integration, automation, observability enhancements, cloud connectivity, and mainframe transformation programs.
Provide technical leadership, mentorship, operational governance, and strategic guidance to ensure a secure, highly available, and high-performing DB2 infrastructure.  

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

* 8+ years of experience in Mainframe z/OS system programming, with extensive hands-on expertise in z/OS installation, configuration, maintenance, and support.
* Skills in applying patches, managing third-party software and ensuring system reliability.
* Hands-on expertise in SYSRES builds, applying PTFs, performing disaster recovery drills and updating license keys.
* Proficiency in product maintenance, upgrades and compatibility checks for z/OS 3.1 and IBM z16 hardware.
* Adept at troubleshooting any system failures, freeze, job abends and performance issues.
* Willingness to provide 24/7 oncall support to resolve any system issues.
* Working knowledge of mainframe GDPS.
* Good understanding of flip and stay disaster recovery model.
* Experience of working on many migration projects as part of mainframe modernization.
Should provide recommendations on optimizing system performance.  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* Experience in z/OS administration.
* Experience in mainframe modernization initiatives.
* Experience of supporting the IBM z16 and IBM z17 mainframe systems.
Any leadership and mentoring experience will be an added plus.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

* 8+ Years of Experience in Mainframe Storage Administration.
* Experience with DASD and tape data storage solutions (Experience on DASD/Tape Configuration and Migration) for mainframes.
* Candidate should possess working knowledge of Z/OS Operating System, z/OS(MVS) fundamentals, Storage fundamentals and Storage Devices.
* Candidate will be expected to have good knowledge in the following areas: TSO, ISPF, JCL, VSAM, ISMF, JES2, Catalogs, Datasets (PS/PDS/PDSE/GDG), REXX, SAS, SDSF and Spool.
* Candidate will be expected to have good knowledge & Experience in the following (: MF - Tape & DASD Management) areas: DFSMS, DFSMSHSM, DFSMSDSS, DFSMSDFP, DFSMSRMM, ICF Catalog, VSAM, IDCAMs, CA products (CA Disk, CA allocate and CA-1), FDR products, Omegamon XE or related Storage monitoring tools, ICKDSF, Space abends and SMF/Dcollect/BVIR reports.

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field.
* Provides technical support activities for a production mainframe environment of multiple LPARs, CECs, DASD and VTS controllers.
* Experience in Storage box data migration (DASD to DASD and Tape to tape) and Storage replication.
* Candidates have to work in customer work hours- US, Europe and Asia Pacific (weekends and holidays as on call staff).

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

We're looking for a **Senior** **Salesforce Security Architect** to define, design, and govern the security architecture of our enterprise Salesforce ecosystem. The role will establish scalable security patterns and controls across identity and access management, data protection, application security, integrations, monitoring, compliance, and emerging Salesforce capabilities.

The architect will partner with Enterprise Security, Salesforce platform teams, application development teams, business stakeholders, and compliance teams to ensure Salesforce solutions follow enterprise security requirements and the principles of least privilege, defense in depth, secure-by-design, and auditable access.

  
Responsibilities:

**Security Architecture & Governance**

* Define and maintain the Salesforce security architecture, standards, patterns, and guardrails.
* Perform security architecture reviews for new Salesforce solutions, integrations, and major platform changes.
* Identify security risks and recommend appropriate technical controls and remediation strategies.
* Ensure security architecture aligns with enterprise cybersecurity, privacy, risk, and compliance requirements.
* Provide security guidance to Salesforce administrators, developers, architects, and delivery teams.

**Data Security & Privacy**

* Define approaches for protecting confidential and sensitive information stored in Salesforce.
* Establish data classification and protection standards.
* Review data access patterns and prevent inappropriate exposure of sensitive information.
* Provide security architecture for data movement between Salesforce and downstream/upstream enterprise systems.

**Salesforce Shield & Security Monitoring**

* Architect and govern the use of Salesforce Shield capabilities.
* Define security monitoring and auditing requirements using Event Monitoring and platform audit capabilities.
* Establish integration patterns between Salesforce security events and enterprise SIEM/security-monitoring platforms.

**Secure Development & DevSecOps**

* Partner with development teams to identify security vulnerabilities during solution design and implementation.
* Incorporate security reviews into Salesforce development and release processes.
* Drive remediation of security findings and technical security debt.

title: Lead Infrastructure Engineer - NCS Telecom Implementation
description:

title: Senior Identity Engineer - IT Risk and Security
description:
Overview:

**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.**  
  
With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.  
  
Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.

**Business Segment Overview**

**Corporate:** Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies.

**Position Purpose:** As Senior Identity Engineer for IT Risk and Security, you will be a senior hands-on engineer responsible for operating, improving, automating, securing and troubleshooting the enterprise identity platforms the firm depends on. The estate of platforms include Identity Providers, legacy directory services, enterprise PKI, privileged access management, modern authentication and identity governance tooling, alongside legacy platforms now being retired. This is a senior individual contributor role, not an architect role — the ideal candidate is deeply hands-on, comfortable owning complex, ambiguous identity problems end to end with minimal supervision, and raises the standard of the engineers around them. Experience working in a regulated financial environment is a plus.

Responsibilities:

**Primary duties will include:**

* Design, build and operate identity services across core identity provider platforms—Entra ID with hybrid directory services and Okta—including authentication journeys, application integration, federation and single sign-on at scale; implement, test, troubleshoot and monitor access policies, Conditional Access, MFA, passwordless authentication, authentication strengths, session controls, policy exclusions and emergency access safeguards.
* Operate and troubleshoot Active Directory in large, complex, multi-domain and multi-forest environments, including domain controllers, DNS and name resolution, Sites and Services, replication, Group Policy, trusts and cross-domain authentication, service accounts, privileged groups, delegated access and domain health; coordinate changes across dependent systems.
* Serve as a senior escalation point for complex identity incidents — authentication failures, provisioning issues, certificate-related outages, privileged access problems and production change failures — determining cause, escalating anything with ongoing or immediate impact, performing root cause analysis and driving the problem to a permanent fix.
* Plan, execute, validate and document production identity changes, including risk assessment, implementation steps, rollback planning, stakeholder coordination, functional and connectivity testing, and post-change monitoring.
* Grow the joiner, mover and leaver lifecycle — provisioning and deprovisioning driven from authoritative HR sources, and policy and role-based entitlement in place of ticket-by-ticket approval.
* Support PKI and certificate lifecycle operations as they relate to identity services — TLS certificates, certificate-based authentication, domain controller certificates, renewal, revocation checks and outage troubleshooting.
* Automate repeatable identity administration, reporting, validation, reconciliation and remediation using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, source control and pipeline-based workflows, applying configuration-as-code to identity change rather than manual administration.
* Develop group policies and access control lists, design and build system administration and management functionality for privileged access users, maintain baseline system security, and resolve vulnerabilities in identity systems and components through documented remediation plans.
* Maintain the resilience of the service: define availability levels, determine disaster recovery and continuity of operations requirements, and develop, test and execute recovery and alternate-site procedures for identity platforms.
* Own operational documentation for the identity services you support — SOPs, runbooks, implementation records, troubleshooting guides, escalation procedures, known-error documentation and workflow diagrams — kept current with the deployed design and to a standard that allows work to move between regions without loss.
* Produce audit-ready evidence for identity controls — privileged access, access reviews, account lifecycle events, group membership, policy changes, app permissions, certificate ownership and remediation actions — supporting internal audit, external audit and client or scheme assessments including SWIFT CSP, defending design decisions and closing findings to agreed dates.
* Collect metrics and trending data, develop cybersecurity and performance success metrics, and examine service performance reports for issues and variances so identity risk is visible without a manual data pull.
* Mentor and upskill engineers across the team through code and design reviews, interactive training and knowledge transfer, building genuine cover so that every platform has more than one engineer, in more than one region, who can safely operate it.
* Establish internal and external cross-team relationships — with security architecture, security operations, enterprise IT, HR, compliance and application teams — to gather requirements, translate proposed capabilities into technical requirements and deliver identity solutions that meet business needs.

Qualifications:

**To land this role you will need:**

* This individual must be capable of working with internal and customer-facing teams to facilitate process improvement and customer support resulting in an enhanced security posture, reduction in risk and improvement in end-user experience. Excellent communication, strong organizational skills and attention to detail are essential.
* 5+ years in identity and access management in a hands-on engineering or operations role, with a track record of independently delivering complex identity change in a large, distributed estate; experience in financial services a plus.
* Deep, current, hands-on experience operating Active Directory in large, complex environments — domain controllers, Sites and Services, replication, Group Policy, trusts, service accounts, privileged groups and domain health troubleshooting — including multi-domain or multi-forest estates with cross-domain authentication and delegated access.
* Equivalent depth in Microsoft Entra ID — tenant configuration, directory synchronization, conditional access, privileged role management, entitlement models, enterprise applications and app registrations — and in Okta, covering policy architecture, authentication journeys, application integration, lifecycle management and federation at scale.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across authentication, authorization, federation, directory synchronization, MFA, Conditional Access, certificates, DNS, LDAP, Kerberos, SAML 2.0, OIDC, OAuth 2.0 and SCIM.
* Working knowledge of PKI and certificate lifecycle operations as they relate to identity services, including TLS certificates, certificate-based authentication, domain controller certificates, renewal, revocation checks and outage troubleshooting.
* Demonstrated experience governing non-human identities — service accounts, managed identities, app registrations, API clients and automation accounts — including secrets and certificate handling, ownership records, permission reviews and decommissioning.
* Strong automation ability using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and REST APIs, including the Okta management APIs, with practical use of source control, pipelines and configuration-as-code applied to identity administration, reporting, validation, reconciliation and remediation.
* Knowledge and implementation of key security concepts such as RBAC, zero trust, identity lifecycle automation, least privilege and identity governance.
* Expert command of change management process and discipline; you are expected to plan, document and execute high-risk identity change on production platforms with minimal guidance, including rollback planning and post-change validation.
* Demonstrated operational engineering discipline: incident, problem and change management, root cause analysis, service level reporting, and the development and maintenance of standard operating procedures, runbooks and known-error documentation.
* Direct experience supporting identity controls through audit — preparing evidence, defending design decisions to auditors or regulators, and closing findings.
* Understanding of a broad range of general information security domains, including networking, cybersecurity, governance and risk, and cloud.
* Advanced written and verbal communication skills, sufficient to explain identity design decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders, answer requests for information directly, and communicate critical or time-sensitive information to leadership.
* Experience with a cohesive PAM/IGA program

**What makes you stand out**:

* You have an engineer's instinct; you see an inefficient process and immediately think of how to automate it away rather than staff it.
* You thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and are comfortable carrying live service ownership and a delivery backlog at the same time.
* You are equally comfortable in both platforms and can reason about where a capability belongs — Entra ID or Okta — rather than defaulting to the one you know best.
* You are the person others escalate to, and you close the loop by documenting what you found so the next engineer does not have to rediscover it.
* You leave the estate better documented and better understood than you found it, and you deliberately build capability in the engineers around you.
* You have experience in a Zero Trust program, or with securing non-human identities including service accounts, workload identities and emerging agentic and AI workloads.
* Education / Certification Requirements:
* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, information security or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300) preferred.
* Okta Certified Professional or Okta Certified Administrator preferred; Okta Certified Consultant a plus.
* CISSP, CISM, CyberArk Defender or Sentry, or an equivalent identity governance credential preferred; ITIL foundation or equivalent service management training is a plus.
* Significant experience with demonstrated examples of growing PAM and/or IGA programs
* Production delivery experience across at least three of: identity governance and administration tooling, privileged access management such as CyberArk, PKI and certificate lifecycle management, federation and single sign-on, and multi-factor or passwordless authentication.

**Working environment**:

* Team distributed across UK, US and GCC locations; **expected business start time (2:00 - 2:30 PM IST) to overlap some of US business hours** and participation in an escalation and on-call rotation should be expected.
* 4 days' a week in office.

Project Manager - MEP
  
  
**What this job involves:**  
Being the go-to MEP personAre you considered to be the go-to person for all MEP matters? That’s what you’ll be in this role. You’ll manage all activities related to mechanical, engineering and plumbing in terms of planning, designing, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning, and final handover. Your task is to fully understand, collect and deliver clients’ MEP requirements. The design manager in MEP will depend on you to help schedule or plan establishment, value engineer, and design change management. You’ll also assist the contract manager in MEP-related procurement and VO management. On top of that, you’ll support the construction manager in MEP-related installation, site inspection and contractor management. Making visions come trueYou’ll develop big ideas that will spark the effective management and successful execution of all phases of a project—from initiating, designing, planning, controlling, executing, monitoring, and closing. You’ll need to carefully identify and take note of our clients’ needs, and figure out what exactly needs to be done. This involves defining the scope of the work and expected outcome, while also detailing all the necessary objectives to get there. While you do all of these, you’ll need to keep tabs on company resources used in the projects, and to allocate these resources to complete the project within the budget. You’ll also need to help clients organize and analyze all tender and procurement for all contractors and suppliers; and represent them from the beginning to the end of a project. Building strong teams and business reputationOne of your priorities will be to produce high-performing teams that drive successful project execution. You’ll also represent and promote the company throughout projects and in pursuit of more project opportunities. Keeping risks at bayHow do you deal with risks? You’ll need to identify any potential risks in the MEP field and report them to the Project Manager. It will be critical to design a risk management and solution provision, particularly to identify health & safety issues. You will understand why this is your responsibility. Sound like you? To apply you need to be: An MEP proYou have a degree in MEP engineering-related discipline or related field, and five years of combined educational and work experience. You also need to have sufficient experience in construction site management, as well as a strong understanding of all aspects of development management including, financial appraisal, risk management, negotiation, etc.
  
Do you have a strong background of all aspects of MEP-related management—including the development of MEP project plan and procedures and construction schedules? Are you familiar with HVAC, electrical engineering, and BMS? Do you have knowledge of security system, AV system, and IT system? If your answers are yes, let’s talk. A business savvy leader who can walk the talkYou understand the business well enough, particularly in terms of the systems and tools to use, the best practices and the safety requirements. You’re also knowledgeable of key industries and local market, with the real estate and construction business above all. You also have a basic understanding of the key drivers that push the projects forward, while also considering the client’s business requirements. You’ll back up your business know-hows with the necessary communication skills, as you need to regularly do business development presentations to potential clients in both English and Chinese. You’ll also manage site activities, negotiate with contractors, review the legal aspects of contracts, contribute to market analysis, and manage change orders. A flexible leader with superb interpersonal skillsAre you a people person with superb interpersonal skills? You’ll need to create a proactive working environment that not only motivates your employees, but also encourages them to maintain good relationship with clients, communicate effectively with each other, and contribute enthusiastically to the project. You also need to be a results-oriented leader with good problem-solving skills, as well as someone who can nurture positive relationships with all stakeholders involved, including your team members and clients. What we can do for you: At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
  
Apply today!
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Principal Software Engineering Manager
description:
**Overview**  

The Microsoft Security organization’s mission of making the world a safer place has never been more important. As threats become more frequent and sophisticated, we drive improvements into our security products that keep our customers, applications, and devices safe. Security is one of the fastest growing, highly collaborative teams with an entrepreneurial mindset within Microsoft.

The Microsoft Defender family offers comprehensive threat prevention, detection, and response capabilities for everyone – from individuals looking to protect their family to the world’s largest enterprises. Linux servers run highly business-critical workloads for our customers and are increasingly targeted by attackers seeking to disrupt those workloads. Microsoft Defender for Endpoint provides a security solution to help protect Linux servers with high performance, quality, and innovative security capabilities. We are hiring a Group Engineering Manager for this product area. Our work provides peace of mind to customers by helping them protect their critical assets.

Our team includes people from a wide variety of backgrounds, previous work experiences, and life journeys, and we are eager to maintain and grow that diversity. We are passionate about learning on the job, collaborating with other teams, and staying deeply focused on customer needs. Join us to build easy-to-use cybersecurity products that positively impact over a billion users from all walks of life.

  
**Responsibilities**

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead, mentor, and grow a talented and diverse team of engineers focused on delivering products that create deep customer value. You will partner with other Engineering Managers, Architects, and cross-functional leaders to build a sustainable, high-performing team and foster an engineering culture focused on delivering products our customers love.

You will collaborate across teams to develop innovative solutions that protect Linux servers through Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and contribute to the growth of the business. You will provide strong technical and people leadership, establish engineering rigor, foster a data- and results-driven culture, and build an environment of collaboration, inclusion, and trust.

You will also help drive the adoption and impact of Microsoft Security products while enabling your team to deliver high-quality solutions at scale.

If you are passionate about **Linux, cybersecurity, engineering excellence, and building high-performing teams**, this role offers an exciting opportunity to bring those passions together.

 **Qualifications**  

* **12+ years of experience in software engineering**, with experience building enterprise software and a proven track record of shipping commercially successful software products and services.
* Demonstrated ability to **lead, mentor, nurture, and grow engineering talent**.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams comprising Software Engineers, Program Managers, Security Researchers, and Data Scientists.
* **3+ years of experience leading and building engineering teams**.
* **7+ years of experience designing and developing applications and systems on Linux**.
* **7+ years of experience applying software development principles, design patterns, and engineering best practices**.
* Strong understanding of **Linux internals** and experience building Linux-based products.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Familiarity with **secure software development lifecycle (SDL) practices**.
* Experience with software development tools and systems, including source control systems such as Git, automated build systems, compilers, software validation systems, project tracking tools, and lifecycle management systems.
* Ability to work independently and drive complex **technical and architectural decisions and dependencies**.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience building **Linux kernel modules**.
* Contributions to **Linux open-source projects**, particularly in the kernel space.

**Experience:** 7 Years Total | Minimum 5 Years Relevant  
**Role:** Snowflake DBA / Cloud Data Platform Administrator  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time / Contractual (as per project requirement)

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Snowflake Database Administrator (DBA)** with strong expertise in Snowflake administration, cloud infrastructure, database security, access management, release management, disaster recovery and operational support.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience managing enterprise Snowflake environments, implementing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), configuring network policies, managing production releases and performing periodic operational and security reviews.

The candidate should also possess working knowledge of **AWS EC2, S3, Linux, Azure Key Vault, Azure DevOps pipelines and Medallion Architecture**.

Key Responsibilities1. Snowflake Database Administration

* Administer and maintain Snowflake environments across development, testing and production.
* Manage databases, schemas, warehouses, roles, users and access privileges.
* Monitor warehouse performance, resource utilization, query execution and storage consumption.
* Perform routine database health checks, maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Support Snowflake configuration changes, upgrades and operational improvements.
* Manage Snowflake tasks, streams, stages and data-loading configurations.

2. Security, RBAC and Network Policies

* Implement and maintain Snowflake Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
* Configure and manage network policies, network rules and access restrictions.
* Administer user accounts, service accounts and access permissions.
* Perform periodic user-access reviews, privilege audits and security compliance checks.
* Troubleshoot authentication, authorization and connectivity issues.
* Support secure credential management and access governance.

3. Bundle Release Change (BCR) Management

* Participate in Bundle Release Change (BCR) activities.
* Coordinate and execute approved database configuration and release changes.
* Perform pre-deployment validation and post-deployment verification.
* Maintain change records, deployment documentation and rollback procedures.
* Coordinate release activities across development, QA, production and infrastructure teams.

4. Routine and Periodic Reviews

* Conduct daily, weekly and monthly Snowflake operational reviews.
* Review warehouse utilization, failed queries, scheduled jobs and system alerts.
* Perform periodic access, network policy and security configuration reviews.
* Identify operational risks, performance bottlenecks and recurring issues.
* Prepare review reports, audit evidence and operational documentation.

5. Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity

* Support Snowflake disaster recovery and business continuity procedures.
* Work with Snowflake Time Travel, Fail-safe concepts, database replication and failover capabilities.
* Participate in disaster recovery drills and recovery validation.
* Maintain recovery procedures and support RPO/RTO objectives.
* Investigate failures and support restoration of database services.

6. AWS Infrastructure Integration

* Work with AWS S3 buckets for Snowflake data ingestion and external stages.
* Understand IAM roles, bucket policies, storage integrations and access permissions.
* Support AWS EC2-based applications, utilities and connectivity requirements.
* Troubleshoot Snowflake-to-AWS connectivity and permission issues.
* Coordinate with cloud infrastructure teams on configuration and access management.

7. Linux Administration and Scheduling

* Perform basic Linux administration and troubleshooting.
* Work with Linux commands, file permissions, logs and shell scripts.
* Manage and troubleshoot basic crontab scheduling activities.
* Monitor scheduled scripts, jobs and operational tasks.

8. Azure Integration and DevOps

* Understand Azure Key Vault for secure storage and management of secrets.
* Possess basic knowledge of Azure DevOps pipelines and CI/CD processes.
* Support deployment and configuration activities involving Snowflake environments.
* Coordinate with DevOps teams for automation and secure release management.

9. Data Architecture and Integration

* Demonstrate understanding of Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver and Gold layers).
* Understand data ingestion, transformation, validation and consumption workflows.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to resolve data pipeline and integration issues.
* Support data governance, data quality and platform reliability initiatives.

Mandatory Technical Skills

* Minimum 5 years of relevant Snowflake DBA experience.
* Strong hands-on Snowflake database administration.
* Snowflake RBAC, roles, grants and access management.
* Snowflake network policies and security configuration.
* Bundle Release Change (BCR) and production change management.
* Routine and periodic database operational reviews.
* Disaster recovery, replication and recovery procedures.
* AWS S3 and EC2 working knowledge.
* Linux fundamentals and basic crontab operations.
* Azure Key Vault and basic Azure DevOps pipeline knowledge.
* Understanding of Medallion Architecture.
* Strong SQL and database troubleshooting skills.

Preferred Skills

* SnowPro Core or SnowPro Advanced certification.

* Experience with AWS IAM, CloudWatch and cloud monitoring tools.
* Knowledge of Terraform, scripting or infrastructure automation.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes, incident management and change management.
* Experience with audit compliance and security governance.
* Exposure to ETL/ELT pipelines and enterprise data platforms.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
* Approximately 7 years of total IT experience, including at least 5 years in Snowflake administration or closely related cloud data platform operations.
* Proven experience supporting production systems and resolving critical incidents.

title: Assistant Branch Manager
description:
**Job Purpose**

To lead branch setup and operational readiness, drive business growth in gold lending, build and manage a high-performing branch team, and ensure strict compliance with internal audit standards and regulatory (RBI) guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Branch Recruitment & Team Building:**
* Source, interview, and hire local talent for key branch roles, including Gold Valuers/Appraisers, Customer Service Officers, Relationship Managers, and Security Personnel.
* Coordinate with HR to manage local hiring pipelines, campus/walk-in drives, and employee onboarding.
* Plan branch staffing levels based on business volume and operational requirements.
* Oversee initial product, compliance, and gold-appraisal training for newly onboarded staff.
* **Business Development & Sales:**
* Drive branch sales targets for gold loan disbursements, cross-selling products, and new customer acquisition.
* Execute local marketing activities and maintain relationships with local business communities to generate leads.
* Oversee loan renewal mix and repeat customer retention strategies.
* **Gold Operations & Risk Management:**
* Ensure accurate gold testing, weighing, and purity assessment following standard appraisal protocols.
* Strictly adhere to Loan-to-Value (LTV) limits and regulatory guidelines.
* Supervise safe vault management, dual-custody procedures, and daily packet verification to protect pledged gold assets.
* **Operations & Compliance:**
* Oversee daily branch transactions, cash management, and operational workflows.
* Maintain compliance with company policies, RBI guidelines, and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) norms.
* Ensure smooth internal and external audit processes and resolve audit queries promptly.
* **Portfolio & Recovery Management:**
* Track overdue loans and lead recovery efforts for early-stage delinquent accounts (0–30 days past due).
* Coordinate loan closure, redemption processes, and statutory auctions for non-performing accounts per legal guidelines.
* **Team Leadership & Customer Service:**
* Manage, mentor, and retain branch staff, providing regular performance evaluations and coaching.
* Resolve escalated customer grievances and ensure high-quality service delivery.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Hiring & Retention:** Time-to-fill for open branch positions, staff onboarding timeline, and branch attrition rate.
* **Growth:** Total Assets Under Management (AUM) and monthly disbursement volume.
* **Risk & Portfolio:** Non-Performing Assets (NPA) percentage and audit compliance score.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Business, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 3–8 years in banking/NBFC operations, with proven experience in branch management, team hiring, and gold loan processing.
* **Technical Skills:** Interviewing techniques, knowledge of gold appraisal methods, basic accounting, and branch management software.
* **Soft Skills:** Talent acquisition, team leadership, conflict resolution, sales strategy, and local language proficiency.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid sick time

title: MF Platform Support-Infrastructure Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Your role
  
Step into the engine room of enterprise technology, where every decision you make can shape how a customer’s systems perform today - and scale for tomorrow. You’ll dive deep into complex infrastructure environments, solving challenging technical problems, designing seamless integrations and ensuring systems run reliably at every level. Your expertise across networks, endpoints and mainframes, paired with a knack for logical problem-solving and clear documentation, will guide projects from concept to execution. Your solutions will make a real impact that customers notice and remember.
  
  
In this role, you’ll balance hands-on delivery with long-term strategic planning. From analyzing issues and testing solutions to automating processes and integrating across platforms, your work will touch every layer of IT infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with Architects, Technicians and Project Managers, gaining broad exposure and continuous opportunities to grow your skills and influence.
  
  
What you will do

* Diagnose and resolve complex infrastructure issues across servers, networks, cloud platforms, and enterprise systems by identifying root causes and implementing effective solutions.
* Design, deploy, and integrate end-to-end infrastructure solutions across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments to ensure seamless operations.
* Automate workflows, processes, and system tasks to improve reliability, efficiency, scalability, and operational consistency.
* Assess technical risks proactively and implement preventive measures to minimize disruptions and maintain business continuity.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Architects, Project Managers, and technical specialists, to deliver successful project outcomes.
* Lead infrastructure projects from planning through execution, ensuring high-quality delivery within agreed timelines and customer expectations.
* Communicate technical solutions and architecture recommendations effectively to customers and stakeholders, building trust through measurable business impact.
Continuously expand expertise in cloud technologies, enterprise IT systems, and emerging technologies while pursuing professional certifications and career growth opportunities.  

  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.

Your Future at Kyndryl
  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior Administrator to Architect. We have training and upskilling programs that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with customers in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important-you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused-someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless-naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

Required skills and experience
  

* 8+ years of experience and deep expertise within specific technology domain areas (e.g., software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics)
* Enterprise IT application experience
* Hands-on experience in at least one of the following: software development, DevOps engineering, systems administration, or systems architecture in public cloud AWS domain
* In-depth knowledge of Windows and Linux Operating System

  
Preferred skills and experience
  

* Familiar with a variety of IT concepts, practices, and procedures
* Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principals involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models
* Logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems
* Analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Associate Client Support Engineer
description:
**Overview**  
**About the Role:**  
The Operations Analyst (OA) will work with a Client Operations Manager and a multi-functional team in the day-to-day operations of real-time, high-volume, multi-channel marketing solutions.  
  
The OA will ensure operational excellence on multiple accounts, maintaining operational processes, tools, and deliverables to deliver high quality and on-time completion of client work per contractual obligations which include but are not limited to file processing (inputs and outputs, scheduled and ad hoc), PeopleCloud Messaging (PCM) campaign and message delivery, issue management, and SLA compliance.  
  
A major factor in the ability to grow Epsilon's business with an existing customer is the consistent, flawless execution and delivery of daily processes and deliverables, making the OA position a key contributor to Epsilon's growth strategy.  
  
**The ideal candidate:**  

* Up-to-date knowledge of Digital Solutions Landscape with enterprise-scale solution delivery experience in Marketing Technology (Loyalty / CRM / Email / Marketing Ops)
* A unique blend of business and technical savvy; ability to partner with the clients and internal contributors including architects, developers, product owners and infrastructure administrators to implement operational excellence, and the delivery know-how to make the vision a reality
* Ability to clearly communicate technical issues in writing and verbally. Candidate will be required to read technical specifications and validate data extracts and reporting based on previously defined business requirements.
* Responsible for performing and monitoring production processes and functions. This includes troubleshooting and escalation of incidents and anomalies in processing.
* Good understanding of Operational standards (ITIL framework)
* Quick learner in a fast paced, challenging work environment to resolve time bound issues
* Eagerness to learn technologies and domains
* Ability to clearly communicate technical problems verbally and in written form
* Desire to gain knowledge related to the clients' industry and current business, and incorporate this knowledge into the overall technical solution
* Desire to learn Cloud platform solutions (Azure/AWS/GCP)
* Desire to learn Infra-Ops processes and tools
* Understanding of SQL and ETL is a big plus
* Knowledge of Enterprise tools like ServiceNow, Thousand Eyes, Ops Ramp and ELK
* Detail oriented, ability to multi-task and a great teammate

**Responsibilities**  

* Accountable for day-to-day solution operations; work with operational teams to provide error-free solutions, contribute to continuous improvement across people, processes, and technology to reduce manual work, increase delivery predictability, improve quality and increase client satisfaction.
* Aid in introducing improvements and enhancements in operations and infrastructure including process automation and PCM campaign delivery to increase quality of work and team productivity, including the implementation and coordination of on-going monitoring and alerting across the client solution
* Enforce guidelines, standards, and methodology on assigned account(s) to improve quality, repeatability, and on-time delivery of client marketing activities
* Find opportunities for organizational efficiencies and open communication throughout the appropriate teams
* Collaborate with delivery teams to ensure quality, completeness, and timeliness of operational solution delivery
* Work with multi-functional teams to conduct root cause analysis and resolve production issues to internal and external client satisfaction.
* Contribute to solution documentation, including core system documentation and operational escalation processes, ensuring accuracy and completeness
* Support the triage and resolution of issues
* Raise critical client issues to leadership to ensure timely resolution
* Stay abreast of the latest marketing technology trends and all of Epsilon's product offerings
* Be proactive and one step ahead by anticipating client's operational needs; seamlessly inform, align, and lead internal partners to meet client demands
* Implement continual account-based operational excellence initiatives
* Manage Production alerts, troubleshoot failures, drive necessary action as per the runbook while maintaining SLA
