description:
**As passionate about our people as we are about our mission.**
===============================================================

**Why Join Q2?**

Q2 is a leading provider of digital banking and lending solutions to banks, credit unions, alternative finance companies, and fintechs in the U.S. and internationally. Our mission is simple: build strong and diverse communities through innovative financial technology—and we do that by empowering our people to help create success for our customers.

**What Makes Q2 Special?**

Being as passionate about our people as we are about our mission. We celebrate our employees in many ways through our year-round Q2 ChangeMakers awards program and global moments of recognition and connection. We invest in the growth and development of our team members through ongoing learning opportunities, internal mobility, and meaningful leadership relationships. We also know that nothing builds trust and collaboration like having fun and giving back together. From company-wide volunteer days to events like our Q2 Homecoming Week—featuring learning, community service, and culture-building experiences—we create opportunities to connect, grow, and make an impact.

**SUMMARY**  
Q2 is seeking an HRIS Administrator to serve as a functional and technical subject-matter expert for the Benefits and Absence modules within our Workday HCM platform. In this role you will own the day-to-day configuration, administration, and integrity of these modules while partnering closely with Total Rewards, Benefits, and Leave Administration leadership to deliver a seamless employee experience. This role works as a paired backup with the Payroll and Time Tracking Administrator, so experience with Workday Payroll and Time Tracking is a plus. You bring proven Workday hands-on expertise and are motivated to drive continuous improvement across the HR technology landscape.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Systems Analysis, Configuration & Technical Excellence**

* Maintain and administer Workday Benefits and Absence modules, including benefit plans, eligibility rules, open enrollment and life event configuration, leave plans, and accrual rules; serve as the primary functional and technical expert for these domains.
* Design and configure multi-step business processes, and lead end-to-end testing cycles for annual open enrollment, plan year changes, and leave policy updates, confirming downstream impacts with stakeholders.
* Troubleshoot and resolve Workday configuration, calculation, and reporting issues by designing durable fixes and evaluating cross-system impacts using systems thinking.
* Provide backup support for Payroll and Time Tracking module administration, partnering with the Payroll and Time Tracking Administrator to ensure continuity of coverage.

**Data Integrity & Quality**

* Ensure data accuracy and system integrity across Benefits and Absence, including enrollment audits, deduction reconciliation with Payroll, and carrier and vendor eligibility reconciliation; lead audit data work and implement data quality improvements.
* Write, maintain, and support standard and custom Workday reports and dashboards; ensure system outputs comply with controls and proactively surface insights to stakeholders.
* Maintain comprehensive system documentation, including configuration workbooks, test results, and help guides across all assigned modules.

**Integrations & Vendor Partnership**

* Support and monitor benefits carrier and vendor integrations (such as medical, dental, vision, 401(k), HSA/FSA, and leave management vendors); resolve file errors, eligibility discrepancies, and enrollment mismatches.
* Partner with benefits brokers, carriers, and third-party administrators on annual plan changes, regulatory updates, and data feed requirements.

**Process Optimization, Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* Review, assess, and recommend improvements to HRIS workflows, user experience, and system processes; design scalable solutions that reduce manual effort and drive operational efficiency.
* Design and implement multi-step automations that streamline HR workflows; integrate AI-enabled tools to improve accuracy and delivery speed.
* Develop and maintain end-user procedures, guidelines, training materials, and documentation; own training design and delivery for open enrollment, system updates, and platform change readiness.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Customer Partnership**

* Lead requirements definition and solution validation with HR, Benefits, Leave Administration, Payroll, and business stakeholders; serve as a trusted advisor recommending system improvements grounded in user feedback and business needs.
* Lead project workstreams for Workday module implementations and enhancements, aligning system decisions to project goals and driving cross-functional alignment.
* Facilitate strong business partnerships with internal stakeholders, keeping all relevant parties informed, enabling meaningful feedback loops, and representing the HR Technology team with excellence.

**EXPERIENCE AND KNOWLEDGE**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of experience in Human Resources, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 5+ years of HRIS experience with a strong focus on Workday Benefits and Absence module configuration and administration.
* Strong understanding of HCM design, structure, functions, and processes, including business process workflows, advanced reporting capabilities, and overall system compliance.
* Working knowledge of the following HR business domains: Benefits Administration and Absence/Leave Management, including applicable regulations (such as ACA, ERISA, COBRA, FMLA, and state and local leave laws).
* Organized, detail-oriented, and effective communicator capable of translating complex technical configurations into clear guidance for HR and business stakeholders.
* Self-starter with a strong desire to seek optimal solutions, share discoveries with colleagues, and drive exceptional results.
* Excellent customer service skills and enthusiasm for developing strong partnerships with internal users and leadership.
* Experience with management of SOX/internal compliance audits preferred.
* Experience with Workday Payroll and Time Tracking modules is a plus, as this role will provide backup support for those functions.
* Experience supporting global Benefits and Absence programs across multiple countries and diverse employee populations preferred.
* Experience working on HRIS or HR Operations teams in a global company, including supporting system configuration and end-user training across geographies preferred.
* Familiarity with HR technology integrations, including benefits carrier feeds, payroll, leave vendors, and third-party systems preferred.

*This position requires fluent written and oral communication in English.*

title: Regulatory Reporting, Assistant Vice President
description:
**Who we are looking for**

  

We are looking for a candidates with 12+ Years of experience in Regulatory Reporting ( MIFID / EMIR/SFTR ). To be successful in this role, candidates should have a strong understanding of financial products, derivatives markets, and trading strategies, as well as familiarity with regulatory reporting requirements and data analysis tools. Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work well under pressure are also essential. A bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or a related field is typically required, along with several years of relevant work experience.

  
  

**Why this role is important to us**

The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets. When owners and managers of institutional assets need research, trading, securities lending and innovative portfolio strategies, they turn to SSGM business unit. As our investment research and trading arm, SSM’s number one goal is to enhance and preserve our clients’ portfolio values by applying technology, optimizing trading, and linking asset classes and markets across the world.

Join us if making your mark in the capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

  
  

**What you will be responsible for**

  

As Regulatory Reporting, Assistant Vice President you will

  
  

The Regulatory Reporting team has the responsibility of ensuring SSM meets itself as well as delegating reporting obligations under EMIR, MiFID, CFTC and SFTR. The team has the responsibility to report the FX and SF transactions emanating from its various trading venues.

  
  

* Proactively scrutinize E2E (end-to-end) deliverables of your vertical and ensure completion of all tasks pertaining to each jurisdiction
* Comprehensive management and monitoring of team deliverables
* Be the most erudite subject matter expert across regulations, process, system architecture, contact points and products
* Operate as the Checker of process and exception management, ensure all Checker activities are performed with sincerity and credibly evidenced
* Be the penultimate implementer of Governance and Controls within Regulatory Reporting process; explore AI capabilities that could eradicate all human and operational risk
* Plug all loopholes which can potentially result into any negative ramifications from Regulators and Auditors
* Take ownership and ensure accuracy and timely maintenance of all SOPS, Checklists, Controls, Error Logs, KPIs and KRIs always
* Absolute Ownership and Accountability of the team deliverables
* Regular engagement with directs as well as skip level employees
* Create an atmosphere of fairness and trust within team where everyone can approach you and share their concerns and challenges without any fear of illegitimate rebuttal
* Devote time to the weakest members of the team, mentor them proficiently and aid them to come up the curve
* Walk the talk, demonstrate the qualities and performance yourself what you preach to people
* Establish credible network with peers and seniors across local and global locations
* Imbibe and reflect State Street cultural traits and values in day-to-day duties
* Establish a culture of continuous learning, improvement, excellence and proactive ideation capabilities within the team
* Create apposite backups for self as well as pivotal members of the team, ensure there is enough fungibility across resources to cater to contingency situations
* Be the primary point of contact of stakeholders preceding the VP, any queries, concerns or requests raised for or within your vertical needs to be routed via you
* Must have in depth functional knowledge on the complete periphery of products and regulations within the gamut of Regulatory Reporting
* Proactively drive continuous improvement initiatives to streamline operating models, gain efficiency, identify and mitigate control gaps by improving existing process
* Work closely with Ops team in collaboration with Technology, Product Owners and Change Management teams to enrich the process and implant strategies for tomorrow
  

  

**What we value**

These skills will help you succeed in this role

  
  

* Communicates effectively and accurately in English
* Strong leadership, management, and organizational skills
* Ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines
* Team player
* Ability to work on own initiative
* Very good management skills
* Self- motivated, flexible, personable
* Good working knowledge of software packages, particularly Microsoft Excel
* Good interpersonal skills and an understanding of the rudimentary aspects of the global financial industry and also to FX Product, Securities Finance Product knowledge with Regulatory reporting of SFTR, EMIR, MIFID and CFTC would be advantageous.
  

  

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

  

* 12+ years of functional work experience in trade and transaction reporting operations - worked in one or more of the Regulations - CFTC/EMIR/MIFID/SFTR
* Reconciliation experience in Regulations is a plus

* Graduate and above preferably in Finance
* B.COM, BBM/BBA. MBA (Finance), M.COM or any degree related to Finance or Commerce
* Professional certifications such as the CFA, CPA, or FRM may also be beneficial.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. description:

It’s not just about your career or job title… It’s about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it’s for each other or our customers, we put People First. Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.

title: Infrastructure Engineer III
description:
The Infrastructure Patching & Security Engineering team ensures the security, stability, compliance, and operational resilience of enterprise infrastructure platforms through proactive patch management, vulnerability remediation, security hardening, automation, and continuous improvement.

The team is responsible for maintaining secure and compliant Red Hat Linux, Windows environments by implementing enterprise patching strategies, addressing security vulnerabilities, reducing infrastructure risk, and ensuring adherence to organizational security standards.

We are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Windows Server, VMware, system administration, OS patching, vulnerability management, infrastructure security, automation, and scripting. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing enterprise-wide patching operations, remediating security vulnerabilities, troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, and driving automation to improve patch compliance and operational efficiency.

  

**Required Experience & Technical Skills**

* 10 years of overall IT infrastructure, system administration, patch management, or infrastructure security engineering experience.
* Strong hands-on experience managing enterprise-wide operating system patching and vulnerability remediation across large-scale infrastructure environments.
* Extensive expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL 7/8/9 or later), including administration, patching, kernel upgrades, troubleshooting, and security hardening.
* Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server 2016/2019/2022 or later, including administration, security updates, patch deployment, and troubleshooting.
* Strong experience with VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, virtualization management, patching, and lifecycle operations.
* Hands-on experience with Linux patch management tools such as Red Hat Satellite, YUM, DNF, and RPM.
* Experience with Windows patch management platforms such as SCCM/MECM, WSUS, or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Strong understanding of vulnerability management processes and remediation using tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management using Ansible.
* Hands-on scripting experience using Python, Bash/Shell scripting, and PowerShell.
* Strong understanding of operating system security hardening, CIS benchmarks, vulnerability remediation, and patch compliance.

description:

The Engineering Team creates high-quality end-to-end experiences for travelers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our focus on customer-centric innovation enables us to develop products that build loyalty and repeat business. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to drive growth and achieve results for our customers and the company.
  
  
The Expedia team is seeking a highly collaborative Salesforce Engineer to join our team. This is a “wear-many-hats” role responsible for designing and configuring solutions in and around Salesforce, with hands-on development and administration, and technically lead the project.

**In this role you will:**
--------------------------

* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable, resilient, and secure Salesforce solutions, services, integrations, and platform components that support Expedia Group products and business operations.

* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of Salesforce features and services, including development, testing, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, incident response, release management, and continuous improvement.
Work across Salesforce, application, data, cloud, and platform domains as needed, demonstrating familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows; applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products; and safely integrating and operating AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve outcomes.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of relevant professional experience with a bachelor’s degree, or 3+ years with a master’s degree.
* Proven experience owning complex software systems end to end, including system design, API design, data modeling, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operations.

title: Senior Linux Administrator
description:
NVIDIA is looking for an exceptional engineer to grow and thrive alongside our Infrastructure team that designs, evaluates, and optimizes the compute inrastructure powering NVIDIA's next-generation silicon design and AI

workloads.You will own the operational health, efficiency and observability of a large Linux compute farm serving NVIDIA's VLSI design teams  
  
**What you'll be doing:**

* In this position, you will own the operational health, efficiency and observability of a large Linux compute farm serving NVIDIA's VLSI design teams, and be the person who can say where the time and the capacity are actually going.
* Profile and debug at the system level - kernel, filesystem, memory and I/O behaviour - when workloads are slow, and turn findings into fixes rather than tickets.
* Drive compute efficiency: memory request-versus-usage accuracy, CPU waste from idle and over-provisioned jobs, and the prediction models behind resource requests.
* Build the observability layer for the farm - telemetry pipelines, metrics and dashboards that make capacity, utilisation and job behaviour visible to engineers and to leadership - and own licence monitoring and expiry alerting across the EDA tool estate.
* This is a hands-on technical role. Day-to-day farm operations and live triage are a core part of it, and you will work directly with the heaviest users on their workload behaviour, since most efficiency gains come from a small number of workflows.

**What we need to see:**

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years in Linux systems administration or infrastructure operations at scale.
* Deep Linux systems and kernel-level expertise - comfortable with perf, eBPF/bpftrace, strace, cgroups, NUMA, memory management, scheduler behaviour and I/O subsystems, and able to use them to find root cause rather than guess at it.
* Demonstrated experience diagnosing and fixing performance problems on large multi-user compute systems.
* Strong NFS and distributed filesystem troubleshooting: metadata versus data path, client behaviour, mount and latency issues.
* Hands-on experience building observability - time-series metrics, log and telemetry pipelines, and dashboards (Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic, or equivalent) - plus strong Python for analysis and automation.
* Familiarity with batch schedulers (LSF, Slurm, or equivalent) and job resource accounting, and a genuine appetite for operational work. Semiconductor/EDA or HPC background is a plus.

title: ServiceNow CMDB Consultant
description:
**Job Purpose and Impact**
--------------------------

* Seeking skilled ServiceNow CMDB Consultant with 8+ years of IT experience and strong hands-on expertise in CMDB administration, CSDM, Discovery, CMDB Health, Operational Analysis, and Hardware Asset Management (HAM). The consultant will work as part of the CMDB team to support CMDB governance, data quality initiatives, service modeling, discovery operations, and continuous improvement of the ServiceNow platform.

**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------

**CMDB Management & Governance**

* Support the design, maintenance, and optimization of the ServiceNow CMDB.
* Ensure CMDB data quality through adherence to governance standards and best practices.
* Assist in defining and maintaining CI lifecycle processes, ownership models, and operational procedures.
* Participate in CMDB audits, data remediation activities, and governance reviews.

**Common Service Data Model (CSDM)**

* Support Implementation and maintenance of ServiceNow CSDM.
* Maintain relationships between Business Applications, Application Services, Technical Services, and Infrastructure CIs.
* Work with application and infrastructure teams to align CMDB data with CSDM standards.
* Assist in service mapping and service modeling initiatives.

**Discovery & ITOM**

* Monitor and support ServiceNow Discovery operations.
* Analyze discovery coverage
* Validate discovered data and work with support teams to improve discovery accuracy.
* Support onboarding new technologies and classes into Discovery.

**CMDB Data Model Management**

* Maintain CMDB class structures, attributes, relationships, and data standards.
* Support CI identification, reconciliation, and normalization processes.
* Assist with onboarding new CI classes and integration sources.
* Ensure compliance with CMDB data model and architecture standards.

**CMDB Health & Data Quality**

* Monitor and improve CMDB Health Dashboard metrics including:
* + Completeness
  + Correctness
  + Compliance
  + Relationship Health
* Perform data analysis and remediation to improve overall CMDB health scores.
* Produce operational reports and dashboards to track CMDB performance and quality trends.

**Operational Analysis & Reporting**

* Analyze CMDB data to identify operational gaps, inconsistencies, and improvement opportunities.
* Develop reports and dashboards for CMDB health, discovery coverage, CI ownership, and data quality metrics.
* Support operational and management reviews with actionable insights.

**Hardware Asset Management (HAM)**

* Support alignment between CMDB and Hardware Asset Management data.
* Assist in reconciliation of hardware assets and configuration items.
* Partner with Asset Management teams to improve asset-to-CI relationships and data accuracy.
* Support lifecycle tracking of hardware assets from procurement through retirement.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 8+ years of overall IT experience.
* 3+ years of hands-on ServiceNow CMDB experience.
* Experience working in enterprise CMDB environments.
* Strong understanding of ITIL processes and Configuration Management principles.

**Required Skills**

* ServiceNow CMDB
* CMDB Data Model
* Common Service Data Model (CSDM)
* ServiceNow Discovery
* ITOM Visibility
* CMDB Health Dashboard
* Operational Data Analysis
* Configuration Management
* Identification & Reconciliation Engine (IRE)
* CI Lifecycle Management
* Data Quality Management
* Service Mapping (preferred)
* Hardware Asset Management (HAM)
* Reporting and Dashboard Development
* ITIL Framework

**Preferred Certifications**

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Discovery
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – HAM
* ServiceNow CSDM Fundamentals
* ITIL 4 Foundation

title: Guest Relation Executive
description:
**Job Summary**  
We are seeking a polished, articulate, and customer-centric **Guest Relations Executive** to manage the first impression and overall visitor experience at our premium real estate sales office and experience centre. As the primary point of contact, you will bridge the gap between incoming clients and our internal Sales and CRM teams.  
The ideal candidate will combine **luxury hospitality standards** with sharp administrative skills to ensure every prospective buyer, channel partner, and high-net-worth individual (HWI) receives a frictionless, premium experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Front Desk & Guest Experience Management**

* **First Impression:** Greet walk-in customers, channel partners, and VIP guests with a warm, professional, and confident demeanor.
* **Lounge Management:** Maintain the presentation, hygiene, and ambience of the reception, waiting lounges, and AV experience rooms.
* **Hospitality Coordination:** Oversee the serving of refreshments and manage pantry staff to match 5-star hospitality standards.

**2. Customer & Site Visit Coordination**

* **Guided Support:** Assist visitors with registration forms and preliminary documentation, providing high-level information about the project layout.
* **Sales Alignment:** Seamlessly tag and route walk-in clients to available Sales Executives using internal rosters.
* **Calendar Management:** Coordinate schedules for site visits, virtual presentations, and alignment meetings between clients and management.

* **Feedback Collection:** Hand out feedback/comment cards to prospects post-tour and maintain accurate digital logs for analysis.
* **Documentation Support:** Maintain physical and digital customer file setups before handing them off to the CRM documentation wing.

title: Branch Manager
description:
**Job Purpose**

To lead branch setup and operational readiness, drive business growth in gold lending, build and manage a high-performing branch team, and ensure strict compliance with internal audit standards and regulatory (RBI) guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Branch Recruitment & Team Building:**
* Source, interview, and hire local talent for key branch roles, including Gold Valuers/Appraisers, Customer Service Officers, Relationship Managers, and Security Personnel.
* Coordinate with HR to manage local hiring pipelines, campus/walk-in drives, and employee onboarding.
* Plan branch staffing levels based on business volume and operational requirements.
* Oversee initial product, compliance, and gold-appraisal training for newly onboarded staff.
* **Business Development & Sales:**
* Drive branch sales targets for gold loan disbursements, cross-selling products, and new customer acquisition.
* Execute local marketing activities and maintain relationships with local business communities to generate leads.
* Oversee loan renewal mix and repeat customer retention strategies.
* **Gold Operations & Risk Management:**
* Ensure accurate gold testing, weighing, and purity assessment following standard appraisal protocols.
* Strictly adhere to Loan-to-Value (LTV) limits and regulatory guidelines.
* Supervise safe vault management, dual-custody procedures, and daily packet verification to protect pledged gold assets.
* **Operations & Compliance:**
* Oversee daily branch transactions, cash management, and operational workflows.
* Maintain compliance with company policies, RBI guidelines, and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) norms.
* Ensure smooth internal and external audit processes and resolve audit queries promptly.
* **Portfolio & Recovery Management:**
* Track overdue loans and lead recovery efforts for early-stage delinquent accounts (0–30 days past due).
* Coordinate loan closure, redemption processes, and statutory auctions for non-performing accounts per legal guidelines.
* **Team Leadership & Customer Service:**
* Manage, mentor, and retain branch staff, providing regular performance evaluations and coaching.
* Resolve escalated customer grievances and ensure high-quality service delivery.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Hiring & Retention:** Time-to-fill for open branch positions, staff onboarding timeline, and branch attrition rate.
* **Growth:** Total Assets Under Management (AUM) and monthly disbursement volume.
* **Risk & Portfolio:** Non-Performing Assets (NPA) percentage and audit compliance score.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Business, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 3–8 years in banking/NBFC operations, with proven experience in branch management, team hiring, and gold loan processing.
* **Technical Skills:** Interviewing techniques, knowledge of gold appraisal methods, basic accounting, and branch management software.
* **Soft Skills:** Talent acquisition, team leadership, conflict resolution, sales strategy, and local language proficiency.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

title: Center Manager
description:
**Job Description – Community Executive**

**Company: GoSpaze**

GoSpaze is a real estate services platform built on professionalism, transparency, and trust. Founded in 2017, GoSpaze began with property marketing services and later expanded into co-working spaces and property management. Today, the company supports the complete real estate journey—from search and discovery to rentals, property management, sales, resale, and co-working solutions. **GoSpaze currently operates 10 co-working centres**, offering flexible and professional workspace solutions to individuals, startups, and enterprises.

**Job Summary**

The Community Executive is responsible for the smooth day-to-day functioning of the GoSpaze co-working centre. The role includes facility operations, housekeeping supervision, vendor coordination, inventory control, and handling walk-in clients and member interactions. The executive ensures a clean, safe, and welcoming environment while supporting client enquiries and converting walk-ins into potential leads through coordination with the sales team.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**Centre & Facility Management**

* Manage daily operations of the co-working centre to ensure uninterrupted services.
* Ensure the centre is clean, safe, and well-maintained at all times.
* Conduct regular inspections of common areas, workstations, meeting rooms, washrooms, and pantry.
* Coordinate minor maintenance and report major issues to the operations team.

**Housekeeping Management**

* Supervise housekeeping staff and ensure cleaning schedules are followed.
* Maintain hygiene and cleanliness standards across the centre.
* Monitor washrooms, pantry, and common areas regularly.

**Vendor Management**

* Coordinate with vendors for housekeeping, security, maintenance, internet, pantry, and other facility services.
* Track vendor performance and ensure timely service delivery.
* Raise service requests and follow up until closure.

**Inventory & Stock Management**

* Maintain inventory of office supplies, pantry items, housekeeping materials, and consumables.
* Monitor stock levels and initiate purchase requests when required.
* Maintain accurate stock records and support cost control.

**Client & Walk-in Management**

* Greet and assist walk-in clients visiting the co-working centre.
* Provide basic information about GoSpaze services, pricing, and facilities.
* Coordinate with the Sales team for walk-in leads, site visits, and follow-ups.
* Ensure walk-in client details are captured accurately and shared with the relevant team.
* Handle client and member queries professionally and ensure timely resolution.

**Member Support & Coordination**

* Act as the first point of contact for existing members regarding facility-related concerns.
* Resolve member complaints related to infrastructure, housekeeping, or services with urgency.
* Ensure a positive client and member experience at all times.

**Reporting & Compliance**

* Maintain daily operational checklists, walk-in registers, and reports.
* Ensure compliance with safety, security, and facility guidelines.
* Support audits and internal reviews as required.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Graduate or Diploma holder from any discipline.
* 1–3 years of experience in co-working, facilities management, hospitality, or customer-facing roles.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel and Microsoft Office tools.
* Well-groomed individual with good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficient in English; knowledge of local languages is an advantage.
* Strong coordination and vendor management skills.
* Customer-focused mindset with problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to multitask and work under pressure.
* Willingness to work flexible shifts and extended hours when required.Top of FormBottom of Form

title: Billing Executive
description:
**Job Title:** Admissions and Billing Executive

**Department:** Admissions and Billing

**Industry:** Healthcare / Hospital

**Reporting To:** Admissions and Billing In-Charge / Department Head

**Location:** Manipal Hospitals, Whitefield.

**Job Summary**

Responsible for managing patient admission, registration, billing, and discharge-related activities while ensuring accuracy of patient records, timely processing of transactions, and a smooth patient experience in accordance with hospital policies and procedures.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Patient Registration and Admission:** Register patients, verify identification and relevant documents, create patient records, and complete admission formalities.
* **Billing and Payments:** Prepare accurate patient bills, process payments, generate invoices, and handle refunds and billing corrections as per hospital policy.
* **Insurance and TPA Coordination:** Coordinate with insurance companies and Third-Party Administrators (TPAs) for cashless approvals, documentation, and billing-related queries.
* **Discharge Processing:** Coordinate with clinical departments, pharmacy, and other concerned teams to facilitate timely bill clearance and patient discharge.
* **Patient Assistance:** Address patient and attendant queries regarding admission procedures, billing, deposits, and payment options professionally.
* **Documentation and Records:** Maintain accurate billing records, admission documents, payment receipts, and supporting paperwork.
* **Coordination:** Liaise with nursing, doctors, insurance, pharmacy, and other hospital departments to resolve admission and billing issues.
* **Compliance:** Follow hospital policies, financial procedures, confidentiality requirements, and applicable regulatory guidelines.
* **Daily Reconciliation:** Verify billing transactions, cash collections, payment records, and pending dues, and report discrepancies to the reporting manager.
* **Customer Service:** Ensure a positive patient experience through clear communication, timely assistance, and efficient handling of concerns.

**Educational Qualification**

* Graduate in any discipline; preference for Commerce, Finance, Business Administration, or Healthcare Management.

**Experience**

* 1–3 years of experience in hospital admissions, patient billing, front office, or healthcare operations preferred.
* Freshers with relevant qualifications and good communication skills may also be considered.

**Required Skills**

* Knowledge of hospital billing and admission procedures.
* Basic understanding of insurance and TPA processes.
* Proficiency in MS Office and hospital information systems (HIS).
* Good numerical, documentation, and coordination skills.
* Strong communication and patient-handling abilities.
* Attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and ability to work in shifts.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Accuracy of billing and patient documentation.
* Timeliness of admissions and discharge processing.
* Billing error and discrepancy rates.
* Timely completion of insurance and TPA documentation.
* Patient satisfaction and query resolution.
* Accuracy of daily cash and billing reconciliation.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹400,000.00 per year

title: Senior Slurm Administrator
description:
NVIDIA is looking for an exceptional engineer to grow and thrive alongside our HPC Infrastructure team that designs, evaluates, and optimizes the compute infrastructure powering NVIDIA's next-generation silicon design and AI

workloads. You'll own Slurm within NVIDIA's VLSI compute environment and provide second-deep coverage across the wider scheduling estate.

**What you'll be doing:**

* In this position, you will own Slurm within NVIDIA's VLSI compute environment and provide second-deep coverage across the wider scheduling estate.
* Administer, configure and tune Slurm clusters - partitions, QOS, accounting, limits, node states and topology - and operate them alongside an existing LSF estate.
* Automate scheduler operations: node onboarding and draining, configuration management, health checks and routine maintenance.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reporting for job throughput, queue wait times and SLA attainment.
* This is a hands-on technical role. You will be in the cluster and the scripts yourself, supporting design engineers during local business hours, and day-to-day operations - queue health and job triage - are a core part of the job rather than a side activity.

**What we need to see:**

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 5+ years in compute infrastructure, with hands-on responsibility for batch scheduling.
* Strong practical Slurm experience: configuration, partitions and QOS, accounting via slurmdbd, node management, and troubleshooting real job failures in production.
* Exposure to a second scheduler, LSF preferred, or a clear appetite to pick one up quickly.
* Solid Linux systems administration - filesystems, NFS, networking, process and resource management.
* Working automation skills in Python and shell, and experience with monitoring and dashboarding tools.
* Comfortable carrying a real operational load - you treat production support and escalations as part of the engineering job. Semiconductor/EDA or HPC exposure is a plus, not a requirement.

title: Principal Engineer - ServiceNow (ITOM)
description:
**Job Title**

As a ServiceNow IT Operations Management (ITOM) Principal Engineer, you will act as a key technical expert and collaborative leader helping shape the design, implementation, and continuous evolution of enterprise-scale ITOM capabilities on our ServiceNow platform.

You’ll work closely with architects, platform teams, product managers, and partners across cloud and infrastructure teams to deliver scalable, secure, and sustainable solutions that support our digital transformation goals.

**In this Role, You’ll**

* Collaborate with IT and business stakeholders to define and evolve ServiceNow ITOM strategies.
* Design scalable ITOM solutions across on-premise, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform).
* Lead and guide teams in platform engineering, configuration, and optimization across Discovery, Service Mapping, CMDB (Configuration Management Database), and Event Management.
* Develop and promote standardized frameworks, automation assets, and reusable solutions.
* Support platform governance, architecture reviews, and continuous technical improvements.
* Integrate observability, monitoring, and automation tools to enhance operational reliability.
* Partner with DevOps and agile teams to improve continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) practices.
* Enable data accuracy and governance through Common Service Data Model (CSDM) adoption.
* Contribute to innovation through proofs of concept and technology evaluation.

**Your Profile**

* Extensive experience (typically 10+ years) in IT operations, design, or engineering, including deep ServiceNow platform expertise.
* Proven experience leading or contributing to enterprise ITOM implementations.
* Strong understanding of Discovery, Service Mapping, CMDB, and Observability practices.
* Familiarity with integrating multiple platforms using REST APIs, Flow Designer, or equivalent methods.
* Proficiency with cloud technologies such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.
* Knowledge of JavaScript, Python, or PowerShell scripting for automation is desirable.
* ServiceNow certifications such as System Administrator (CSA), Application Developer (CAD), or Discovery Implementation Specialist are advantageous.
* Collaborative communication style, problem-solving mindset, and openness to mentoring and continuous learning.

### **What We Can Offer You**

A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.
  
Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.
  
A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.
  
A hybrid working model - We want our employees to do their best work, however the hybrid model works best for them.
  
A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.
  
A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.
  
A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.

description:
**Job Title: ServiceNow Architect**

We are looking for a ServiceNow Architect to lead the overall design, architecture, and governance of the ServiceNow platform. * Deep understanding of ServiceNow architecture, data models, tables, ACLs, and role‑based access.
* knowledge of Data Fabric and Creator Pro addon.
* Strong expertise in ITSM, ITAM and ITOM (required).

* Advanced scripting skills: JavaScript (server and client), Glide APIs, Script Includes, and UI scripting.

* Solid understanding of CMDB relationships, discovery patterns, service mapping, and data governance.

* Strong grasp of ITIL processes and how they map to ServiceNow modules.

**Qualifications**

* 10\+ years of hands‑on ServiceNow experience, including development and administration.

* Strong understanding of platform best practices, architecture principles, and governance.
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery environments.
* ServiceNow certifications such as CSA, CAD, CIS (ITSM/CMDB/HRSD), or CTA are preferred.
* Ability to mentor developers and admins and lead technical discussions.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work with both technical and business stakeholders.

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**About Tarento:**  

Tarento is a fast\-growing technology consulting company headquartered in Stockholm, with a strong presence in India and clients across the globe. We specialize in digital transformation, product engineering, and enterprise solutions, working across diverse industries including retail, manufacturing, and healthcare. Our teams combine Nordic values with Indian expertise to deliver innovative, scalable, and high\-impact solutions.  

We're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**, a testament to our inclusive culture, strong leadership, and commitment to employee well\-being and growth. At Tarento, you’ll be part of a collaborative environment where ideas are valued, learning is continuous, and careers are built on passion and purpose. **Role Overview**  

We are hiring an experienced DevSecOps Engineer with strong expertise in AWS Cloud, container orchestration (Kubernetes / ECS etc.), and secure CI/CD deployments.
The ideal candidate will manage and optimize application deployments, troubleshoot production issues, and apply DevOps and security best practices to ensure high availability, scalability, reliability, and compliance of our cloud workloads. **Key Responsibilities**  

* This role is hands\-on and operational — focused on running, securing, and stabilizing production systems.
* Manage and optimize application deployments across AWS EKS, ECS, and EC2 environments.
* Oversee production operations, incident management, and root cause analysis (RCA) for critical issues.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodePipeline.
* Ensure secure deployment processes through integrated scanning tools (Snyk, Trivy, SonarQube, rapid7\) and vulnerability management.
* Implement \& Monitor system health using CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK, ensuring proactive alerts and observability.
* Administer and manage AWS services including S3, EC2, ECR, ECS, EKS, Lambda (serverless), SNS, SES, and Secrets Manager.
* Configure and secure networking components — VPC, subnets, route tables, NAT gateways, security groups, load balancers (ALB/NLB), CloudFront, API Gateway, and WAF.
* Enforce AWS IAM and network security best practices, including least\-privilege policies and secure key management.
* Collaborate with development and QA teams to optimize application performance, reliability, and security posture.
* Drive and promote a “Security by Design” mindset and SRE\-driven reliability culture within the DevOps ecosystem.

 **Required Skills \& Experience:**  

* Proven hands\-on experience managing AWS production environments — EKS, ECS, EC2, S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, WAF, SNS, SES, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, VPC, IAM.
* Strong understanding of containerization (Docker) and container orchestration (Kubernetes / ECS).
* Proficiency with CI/CD tools — Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline.
* Strong networking knowledge — VPC design, subnets, DNS, routing, SSL/TLS, load balancing, and firewall rules.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices — scanning, policy enforcement, and compliance monitoring.
* Skilled in troubleshooting across infrastructure, networking, and application layers.
* Experience with monitoring and alerting stacks — Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch.
* Scripting experience using Bash, Python, YAML, and JSON.

**Good to Have Skills:**  

* Certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, CKA / CKAD, or AWS SysOps Administrator.
* Familiarity with service mesh (Istio / App Mesh) and policy\-as\-code tools (OPA, Kyverno).
* Experience with runtime security platforms (Falco, Aqua, Prisma Cloud).
* Terraforms, CloudFormation for deployment automation.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and AWS Security Hub / GuardDuty.
* Exposure to incident response automation or resilience engineering practices.

**Education:****BE/BTech**, Information Technology, or related discipline.

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**About Tarento:**  

Tarento is a fast\-growing technology consulting company headquartered in Stockholm, with a strong presence in India and clients across the globe. We specialize in digital transformation, product engineering, and enterprise solutions, working across diverse industries including retail, manufacturing, and healthcare. Our teams combine Nordic values with Indian expertise to deliver innovative, scalable, and high\-impact solutions.  

We're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**, a testament to our inclusive culture, strong leadership, and commitment to employee well\-being and growth. At Tarento, you’ll be part of a collaborative environment where ideas are valued, learning is continuous, and careers are built on passion and purpose. **Role Overview**  

We are hiring an experienced DevSecOps Engineer with strong expertise in AWS Cloud, container orchestration (Kubernetes / ECS etc.), and secure CI/CD deployments.
The ideal candidate will manage and optimize application deployments, troubleshoot production issues, and apply DevOps and security best practices to ensure high availability, scalability, reliability, and compliance of our cloud workloads. **Key Responsibilities**  

* This role is hands\-on and operational — focused on running, securing, and stabilizing production systems.
* Manage and optimize application deployments across AWS EKS, ECS, and EC2 environments.
* Oversee production operations, incident management, and root cause analysis (RCA) for critical issues.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodePipeline.
* Ensure secure deployment processes through integrated scanning tools (Snyk, Trivy, SonarQube, rapid7\) and vulnerability management.
* Implement \& Monitor system health using CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK, ensuring proactive alerts and observability.
* Administer and manage AWS services including S3, EC2, ECR, ECS, EKS, Lambda (serverless), SNS, SES, and Secrets Manager.
* Configure and secure networking components — VPC, subnets, route tables, NAT gateways, security groups, load balancers (ALB/NLB), CloudFront, API Gateway, and WAF.
* Enforce AWS IAM and network security best practices, including least\-privilege policies and secure key management.
* Collaborate with development and QA teams to optimize application performance, reliability, and security posture.
* Drive and promote a “Security by Design” mindset and SRE\-driven reliability culture within the DevOps ecosystem.

 **Required Skills \& Experience:**  

* Proven hands\-on experience managing AWS production environments — EKS, ECS, EC2, S3, CloudFront, API Gateway, WAF, SNS, SES, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, VPC, IAM.
* Strong understanding of containerization (Docker) and container orchestration (Kubernetes / ECS).
* Proficiency with CI/CD tools — Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline.
* Strong networking knowledge — VPC design, subnets, DNS, routing, SSL/TLS, load balancing, and firewall rules.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices — scanning, policy enforcement, and compliance monitoring.
* Skilled in troubleshooting across infrastructure, networking, and application layers.
* Experience with monitoring and alerting stacks — Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch.
* Scripting experience using Bash, Python, YAML, and JSON.

**Good to Have Skills:**  

* Certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, CKA / CKAD, or AWS SysOps Administrator.
* Familiarity with service mesh (Istio / App Mesh) and policy\-as\-code tools (OPA, Kyverno).
* Experience with runtime security platforms (Falco, Aqua, Prisma Cloud).
* Terraforms, CloudFormation for deployment automation.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and AWS Security Hub / GuardDuty.
* Exposure to incident response automation or resilience engineering practices.

**Education:****BE/BTech**, Information Technology, or related discipline.
